baseline: Immediately preceding distinct valid quote for the same package, version, cost, duration, reward basis and model code; both receipt and source-time gaps must be 30-90 seconds. Gaps reset the baseline.
confirmation: Two additional distinct consecutive minute observations after the initial candidate (three total), each satisfying both conditional-return gates and both math checks, with at least 95% of the entry work per BTC. A duplicate, missing or invalid sample interrupts confirmation.
activation: First persisted main-branch trial batch; PR smoke samples are explicitly excluded. Ends automatically 72 hours after its first attempt, without extending on restart.
cadence: 60 seconds within bounded GitHub Actions batches. Inter-batch and scheduling gaps are measured, never hidden or interpolated. This is not a continuous-runtime guarantee.
limitations: The pattern was selected using prior data; only new live samples after activation enter this trial.
The minute-to-minute baseline is intentionally stricter than the earlier sparse retrospective <=20-minute comparison; event rates are not directly comparable.
Two models share reported inputs. Math PASS is consistency, not independent source verification.
Fees, component-level source freshness, executable quotes, delivered work, persistence during the full ticket, and mining outcomes remain unverified.
Repeated observations do not establish continuous conditions or independent mining trials. A confirmation is not a BUY recommendation.
Development trial only: after 72 hours the existing single-snapshot collector resumes. A permanent minute service requires a suitable runtime and measured coverage.
